members: public Mono<Integer> appendRevision(long sampleId, RevisionReason reason, double value, Instant tIngress) { return client.sql("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision_no), 0) + 1 AS next_no FROM event_revision WHERE sample_id = :sampleId").bind("sampleId", sampleId).map((row, metadata) -> row.get("next_no", Integer.class)).one().flatMap(revisionNo -> client.sql("INSERT INTO event_revision (sample_id, reason, value, t_ingress, revision_no) VALUES (:sampleId, :reason, :value, :tIngress, :revisionNo)").bind("sampleId", sampleId).bind("reason", reason.name()).bind("value", value).bind("tIngress", LocalDateTime.ofInstant(tIngress, ZoneOffset.UTC)).bind("revisionNo", revisionNo).fetch().rowsUpdated().thenReturn(revisionNo)); }

public Mono<Instant> findLatestTDevice(String deviceId, MetricKind metric) { return client.sql("SELECT MAX(t_device) AS latest FROM telemetry_sample WHERE device_id = :deviceId AND metric = :metric").bind("deviceId", deviceId).bind("metric", metric.name()).map((row, metadata) -> Optional.ofNullable(row.get("latest", LocalDateTime.class))).one().flatMap(latest -> Mono.justOrEmpty(latest).map(value -> value.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC))); }

public Flux<TelemetrySample> findWindow(String deviceId, MetricKind metric, Instant from, Instant to, int limit) { return client.sql("SELECT device_id, metric, t_device, t_ingress, value, validation_status FROM telemetry_sample WHERE device_id = :deviceId AND metric = :metric AND t_device >= :from AND t_device <= :to ORDER BY t_device ASC LIMIT :limit").bind("deviceId", deviceId).bind("metric", metric.name()).bind("from", LocalDateTime.ofInstant(from, ZoneOffset.UTC)).bind("to", LocalDateTime.ofInstant(to, ZoneOffset.UTC)).bind("limit", limit).map((row, metadata) -> new TelemetrySample(row.get("device_id", String.class), MetricKind.valueOf(row.get("metric", String.class)), row.get("t_device", LocalDateTime.class).toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC), row.get("t_ingress", LocalDateTime.class).toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC), row.get("value", Double.class), ValidationStatus.valueOf(row.get("validation_status", String.class)))).all(); }
